name: ai-safe-earth
note: v2 institutional identity. A clean slate — no value is carried over from the previous kit.

ink.use: deep earth ink — text, rings, dark panels

sea.use: slate sea — the earth disc, links

clay.use: the place — the single warm point, org accent

clayInk.use: clay as text or hover state

projectPoint._rule: Only the place-point ever changes colour. Never recolour the disc, never close the ring.

whitepaper.note: org-level document — uses the organization point

grotesk.use: the institution — letterspaced caps, labels, headings

rules: All three words of the name at one size and one weight, so AI carries no more voice than EARTH.
Clear space equals the radius of the disc.
Minimum width 96px; below that use the core mark alone.
Project-coloured variants have a floor at 64px; below it use the organization mark.
No gradients, no pills, no monospace, no emoji, no diagonal wedge. Square corners, hairline rules.
Layout devices come from the map, not the pitch deck: scale bars, corner ticks, crop marks.
